licence.scope: Owner is the SOHO project (ESA/NASA). Statement taken from the SOHO project's own publications-acknowledgment page (owner's data/publication terms, level 2); it states an open data policy plus a request for credit, not a formal licence text, and covers SOHO data in general rather than the filter-profile files specifically. Source page SVO cites: not recorded in info.json (empty). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
